contract.source: ASCII shipping { base N; free_over N; }, settings in either order, exactly once; ASCII space/tab/CR/LF between tokens; no comments required
contract.numbers: one or more ASCII decimal digits, leading zeros allowed, value 0..1000000; reject signs, fractions, hex, overflow and trailing text
contract.runtime: one decimal command-line total in 0..1000000; print decimal cost plus LF, exit 0, empty stderr; invalid runtime arguments exit 64, empty stdout, stderr contains shipping:
contract.compile_errors: exit 1, empty stdout, no output artifact; stderr contains shipping:LINE:COLUMN: and the substring in compile_diagnostics for that error; line and column are 1-based
contract.native: Linux x86-64 ELF executable compiler: COMPILER SOURCE --emit=native -o OUTPUT, then OUTPUT TOTAL; may use declared installed Clang/linker/libc; no source checkout, parser-generator, VM, Node, Java or Python needed at use time
contract.permitted: tool idiomatic grammar, handwritten glue, runtime, and ahead-of-time or embedded runtime packaging; all effort and installs counted; no edits to compiler/parser-generator core

tasks.prompt: Create the shipping language from an empty project. Below free_over charge base; at or above free_over charge zero. Provide a build command and runnable policy program. Use the shared contract.
Extend T1: fee is an alias for base, including duplicate detection when both spellings occur. Preserve all old syntax and behavior.
Extend T2: free_over is now exclusive. At the threshold charge base; only totals strictly greater ship free. Keep both spellings and all validation.

Repair a seeded duplicate-setting defect in a supplied T3 implementation. Its validator overwrites the previous value instead of rejecting a repeated setting. First retain the failing duplicate-policy receipt, then fix the frontend and pass all T3 behavior and duplicate checks, including base/fee alias collisions.

From an independently supplied correct T1 starter, export a native compiler satisfying the shared native contract. Move only the compiler and unseen guest policy to the evaluator workspace. Compile there, then run the native program on unseen totals. No compiler-core edits. At most 100 authored lines across grammar, frontend, runtime, config and scripts; count pasted code, exclude unchanged starter and verified tool-generated lines.
